_comment: Approved acronyms. Edit via the /settings/acronyms admin page or directly here. Each entry maps an acronym to one or more accepted full forms. The detection pass leaves these alone; everything else gets a Word comment (and a track-change expansion when the full form is known).

TEQSA: Tertiary Education Quality and Standards Authority
STEAM: Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics
OECD: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
UNESCO: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization
